title: Clinical SAS Programmer
summary: Writes SAS (and sometimes R) programs that turn clinical trial data into standard CDISC datasets and the tables, listings and figures used in study reports and drug submissions. Works in the biostatistics team of a pharma company or contract research organisation, next to statisticians and data managers.
dailyDuties: Map raw trial data to SDTM domains from specifications
Derive ADaM analysis datasets from the statistical analysis plan
Program safety and efficacy tables, listings and figures
Double-program and validate a colleague's outputs
Run Pinnacle 21 checks and fix compliance issues
Join study team calls on timelines and data issues

skills.expectation: Write Base SAS, PROC SQL and macro programs on clinical trial data
Map raw EDC data to SDTM domains from study specifications
Build ADaM datasets such as ADSL and BDS from the analysis plan
Produce and validate tables, listings and figures for study reports
Run Pinnacle 21 checks and prepare define.xml and reviewer's guides
Work from protocols, statistical analysis plans and ICH-GCP rules
Understand the statistical methods behind efficacy and safety outputs
Explain programming status and issues to biostatisticians and study teams
Use R or pharmaverse packages where the sponsor asks for them
Automate checks and file handling with small scripts
Co-lead studies and review junior programmers' code
